What it does: No keyword.
Visual direction: A stocky, barrel-chested lawman in his fifties with a huge walrus moustache, heavy brows and a weathered scowl. A wide, battered tan hat with a curled brim; a rust-red paisley bandana; a brown leather vest with brass buttons over a cream shirt with rolled sleeves; a five-point brass star on the chest; a cartridge belt with an oval brass buckle; dark wool trousers. One hand rests on a holstered revolver. He stands on the saloon porch with his other hand on a swinging door. A glowing oil lantern hangs above his shoulder. Behind him the street falls away to a burnt-orange horizon turning purple. Plain and dependable: feet planted, nothing fancy. He is the card every other Cowboy is measured against.

What it does: No keyword.
Visual direction: A lean young gunslinger of about nineteen with wavy dark-brown hair and a cocky half-smile. A tan hat pushed back on his head; a teal neckerchief, the one teal note in the Cowboy palette; a rust leather vest with long tails over a cream shirt; a low-slung gun belt; scuffed boots. He holds a long-barrelled revolver up beside his head, barrel to the sky. The middle of the main street at sunset, the saloon front soft in the distance, dust curling around his boots. Young, quick and sure of himself: weight on one hip, mid-stride, the opposite of the Sheriff's planted stance.

What it does: 돌파: 수호를 가진 적이 없다면 적 부대를 지나쳐 기지에 오브 1개 피해를 줄 수 있습니다.
Visual direction: The same young gunslinger as Billy, same teal neckerchief and rust vest, now riding a chestnut horse with a white blaze and a dark mane. The horse rears mid-gallop; he leans forward in the saddle with the revolver raised and the reins in his other hand. Tooled brown saddle, brass tack. Open ground at the edge of town, a sunset sky behind, a long cloud of kicked-up dust trailing off one side of the picture. Ride: horse and rider are one diagonal streak of motion, hooves off the ground, dust stretched into speed lines.

What it does: 적 부대 하나에서 오브 1개를 제거합니다.
Visual direction: A heavy engraved revolver enters from the left edge, held in a gloved hand, a curl of smoke at the muzzle. A single bullet hangs in mid-flight down the centre of the picture, leaving a spiralling ring of gold light behind it. The empty main street at sunset, seen straight down its length, timber fronts on both sides, a far-off target lost in the glare. One shot, one orb: a single clean gold line through an otherwise still picture.

What it does: 휩쓸기: 부대를 공격하면 나머지 적 부대가 모두 오브 1개를 잃습니다.
Visual direction: The Graveyard Dragon, tamed: the same great horned beast with dark purple scales and a ridged neck, now in Cowboy colours. A heavy harness of brown leather and brass studs crosses its chest; a rust-red bandana is knotted around one horn; a brass star tag hangs from the collar. Its throat and belly glow amber instead of green, and the fire in its jaws is gold. A timber corral at the edge of town at sunset, split rails splintered where it leans on them, the purple of the graveyard hills far behind. Sweep: its head swings across the picture with a wide fan of gold fire that covers the whole width of the frame.

What it does: 유령화: 주문의 대상이 될 수 없습니다.
Visual direction: The Lantern Wraith, bound: a tall hooded phantom in a tattered grey-violet shroud with no face, only two points of light in the dark of the hood. It rises out of a brass railroad lantern like smoke from a bottle, and loops of pale rope hold its wrists. Its light has turned from green to warm amber. A hitching rail on the main street at dusk, the brass lantern hanging from the rail, the sunset behind it showing faintly through its body. Ghostly: from the waist down it thins to mist and the street shows through it, so a bullet-shaped spell would pass straight through.

What it does: 수호: 적은 다른 부대나 기지보다 이 부대를 먼저 공격해야 합니다.
Visual direction: A prairie schooner turned into a barricade: a patched cream canvas bonnet over curved hoops, heavy timber sides reinforced with riveted iron plates and a row of plank shields, tall iron-rimmed wheels chocked with stones. A driver in a slouch hat crouches behind the seat with a shotgun, only his hat and the barrels showing. Parked broadside across the main street at sunset so nothing can pass, lanterns hung along its side, dust settling. Guard: it fills the picture from edge to edge like a wall. Wide, low and heavy, the opposite of a rider.

What it does: 돌파: 수호를 가진 적이 없다면 적 부대를 지나쳐 기지에 오브 1개 피해를 줄 수 있습니다.
Visual direction: A lean deputy scout riding low over the neck of a slim grey pinto horse at a flat gallop. A long tan duster streams behind; a rust-red bandana is pulled up over the nose; a small brass deputy star is pinned to the duster; a carbine sits in a saddle scabbard. Light tack, no baggage. The dry flat outside town at sunset, fence posts blurring past, the horse's shadow stretched long in front of it. Ride: everything leans forward. A lighter, faster shape than Mounted Billy: thin horse, long coat, one clean line of speed.

What it does: 최후의 저항: 전투에서 쓰러지면 싸운 부대가 오브 1개를 잃습니다.
Visual direction: A wiry, grinning miner turned outlaw with a soot-smudged face, a singed ginger beard and a dented bowler hat. A bandolier of red dynamite sticks crosses his chest; more are tucked in his belt. He holds one stick high with its fuse spitting sparks, and shields his eyes from it with a scorched leather glove. The mouth of a timber-framed mine cut at dusk, the lit fuse the brightest thing in the picture, its sparks throwing hard warm light up under his hat. Last Stand: the burning fuse is the whole story. Whoever takes him down is standing too close.

What it does: 정찰: 등장하면 카드를 한 장 뽑습니다.
Visual direction: A tall, weathered tracker with a long dark braid and a calm, narrowed gaze. A wide flat-brimmed hat with a small brass star on the band; a long olive-brown duster; a rifle slung across the back; a brass spyglass raised to one eye; a coiled rope and a canteen at the hip. A rock outcrop above the town at sunset, wind pulling the duster sideways, the valley and both ends of the street tiny and far below. Scout: the spyglass and the high vantage. This is the Cowboy who sees what is coming and draws a card for it.

What it does: 휩쓸기: 부대를 공격하면 나머지 적 부대가 모두 오브 1개를 잃습니다.
Visual direction: A brass multi-barrelled Gatling gun on a two-wheeled timber carriage, crewed by two Cowboys: a broad gunner in a leather apron cranking the handle with his teeth bared, and a wiry loader feeding a tall brass magazine. Barrels blurred with spin, brass casings tumbling out. Dug in behind a low barricade of sandbags and barrels on the main street at sunset, gun smoke rolling off to one side. Sweep: a fan of gold tracer lines spreads from the muzzle across the whole width of the picture, hitting everything in front of it at once.

What it does: 적 부대 하나를 기절시킵니다. 다음 턴에 공격할 수 없습니다.
Visual direction: A spinning rope loop hangs wide open in the centre of the picture, faintly gold along its edge, the rope spiralling back to a gloved hand at the lower corner. Inside the loop, a twist of violet mist is caught and pulled tight. Dusty open ground at sunset, seen from low down so the loop is ringed by sky. Stun: the loop has already closed around the violet shape and stopped it mid-motion. Nothing is hurt; it is held.

What it does: No keyword.
Visual direction: A walking skeleton with a cracked skull and a loose jaw, wrapped in a tattered hooded cloak of faded violet. One rusted iron pauldron is strapped across a shoulder with rotten leather; a notched, rust-eaten dagger hangs in bony fingers. Climbing over a broken tomb wall in the graveyard at night, the full moon behind its shoulder, a wrought-iron lantern with a green flame on the rune gateway beyond. Plain and endless: the Wizards' basic troop, the one their other cards raise, pay and replace.

What it does: 소생: 등장하면 묘지에 있는 마지막 언데드 부대가 오브 1개로 돌아옵니다.
Visual direction: An old wizard with a long tangled white beard and sharp, amused eyes under a crooked wide-brimmed pointed hat set with a green gem. Layered violet robes edged with gold embroidery, a satchel of scrolls on a belt, a gnarled wooden staff topped with a caged green crystal. A small violet vortex turns above his open palm. The graveyard path before the rune gateway at night, green lanterns on the stones, mist around the hem of his robe. Raise: threads of green light run from the staff down into the earth at his feet, where a bony hand is pushing up out of the soil.

What it does: 휩쓸기: 부대를 공격하면 나머지 적 부대가 모두 오브 1개를 잃습니다.
Visual direction: A colossal horned dragon with dark purple scales, a ridged crest down a long neck, torn bat wings and a glowing green throat and belly. Its jaws are open and green fire spills between the teeth. Coiled across jagged purple crags above the graveyard at night, the full moon behind its horns, the rune gateway small below it. Sweep: the fire leaves its mouth as a wide curving arc that crosses the whole picture, not a single jet.

What it does: 적 부대 하나에서 오브 1개를 제거합니다.
Visual direction: A whirlpool of violet light with a pure black centre, tearing a hole in the air a hand's height above the ground. Green sparks spiral into it, and flagstones lift and crack toward it. The graveyard at night, headstones leaning toward the pull, the moon and the rune gateway bent slightly at the edges of the picture. One orb gone: everything in the picture leans inward to one point.

What it does: 유령화: 주문의 대상이 될 수 없습니다.
Visual direction: A tall, thin phantom in a long tattered shroud of grey-violet, its hood holding only darkness and two green points of light. One skeletal hand lifts a wrought-iron lantern on a chain, and the green flame inside is the brightest thing in the picture. It has no legs: the shroud frays into mist. A crossroads on a bare hill outside the graveyard at night, a crooked signpost with blank boards, fog pooled in the hollows, the moon small and high. Ghostly: the fence and the hill show through its body. A Wanted boss: it stands dead centre and looks straight at the viewer.

What it does: 속사: 제물 없이 소환해도 등장한 턴에 공격할 수 있습니다.
Visual direction: A small wiry imp with magenta-violet skin, bat ears, two stubby horns, a barbed tail and a grin full of needle teeth. Ember-green eyes. It is caught mid-leap with both clawed hands stretched forward, trailing green sparks. Bursting out of a crack in a tomb lid at night, splinters of stone still in the air, the moon behind it. Quickdraw: it is already in the air and coming at the viewer. No wind-up, no waiting a turn.

What it does: 함정. 적 부대가 공격하면 먼저 오브 2개를 잃습니다. 그로 인해 쓰러지면 공격은 이루어지지 않습니다.
Visual direction: A heavy rusted iron bear trap with toothed jaws wide open, brass rivets at the hinge and a thick chain staked into the ground. Dust and dry grass are scattered over it so only the teeth catch the light. The dirt of the main street at dusk, seen from ground level. In the soft distance a faint violet glow approaches, and one glowing footprint is already near the jaws. It bites first: the open jaws wait in the foreground between the viewer and whatever is coming.

What it does: 장비. 장착한 부대의 공격력이 +1 됩니다.
Visual direction: An ornate revolver lying on a folded rust-red bandana: a long engraved steel barrel, a brass frame scrolled with vines, an ivory grip inlaid with a small brass star. Six brass cartridges stand in a row beside it. A scarred timber table by a window at sunset, an oil lantern just out of frame throwing warm light across the metal. Gear: a treasure handed to one troop. Lit like a prize, alone, nothing else on the table.

What it does: 장소. 보안관(Lawman) 부대의 공격력이 +1 됩니다.
Visual direction: A square timber jailhouse at the head of the street: a covered porch, a barred window glowing amber, a large brass star mounted above the door, a hitching rail, a rack of rifles just visible through the open doorway, and a wall of weathered poster boards with blank sheets. Sunset behind the roofline, lanterns lit along the porch, long shadows of the hitching rail across the dust. A place that makes every Lawman stronger: the star above the door is the brightest thing in the picture.

What it does: 수호: 적은 다른 부대나 기지보다 이 부대를 먼저 공격해야 합니다.
Visual direction: A wall built of stacked skulls, ribs and thigh bones, bound with rusted iron bands and lit from within by a faint violet glow in the gaps. Skeletal arms reach out of it holding broken tomb slabs as shields. Risen straight out of the graveyard earth at night, soil still falling from it, blocking the path to the rune gateway from edge to edge. Guard: a wall, wide and flat, filling the picture side to side. It has no weapon of its own.

What it does: 정찰: 등장하면 카드를 한 장 뽑습니다.
Visual direction: A large raven with glossy black feathers that shine violet at the edges, one eye glowing green. A thin silver ring etched with a rune circles one leg, and a small rolled scroll tied with violet thread is held in its beak. Perched on a tilted headstone at night, wings half open as if it has just landed, the full moon directly behind it. Scout: it has come back with something. The scroll in its beak is the card it draws.

What it does: 돌파: 수호를 가진 적이 없다면 적 부대를 지나쳐 기지에 오브 1개 피해를 줄 수 있습니다.
Visual direction: A rider in a high-collared black-violet greatcoat with tarnished silver buttons and no head: green witch-fire flares up out of the empty collar. One gauntlet holds a curved cavalry sabre. The horse is black and skeletal at the ribs, with green flame for eyes and green fire around its hooves. Galloping along the graveyard wall at night, mist torn apart by its passing, bare trees whipping by. Ride: the Wizards' rider. The same forward-leaning streak as the Cowboy riders, in night colours, hooves off the ground.

What it does: 최후의 저항: 전투에서 쓰러지면 싸운 부대가 오브 1개를 잃습니다.
Visual direction: A knee-high scarecrow creature with a carved pumpkin for a head, lit from inside by green fire through a jagged grin and triangle eyes. A ragged burlap body stuffed with straw, twig arms and legs, and a curling stem on top that burns like a fuse. Standing on a mound of fresh grave earth at night, its own green light the only light on the ground around it. Last Stand: the burning stem is a fuse, the mirror of the Dynamiter's. It is small, it will fall, and it will take an orb with it.

What it does: 모든 적 부대에서 오브 1개씩 제거합니다.
Visual direction: Columns of green and violet fire falling from a split in the night sky and bursting where they land, a dozen at once across the whole width of the picture. The main street seen from the Wizard end at night, fence posts and a wagon wheel in black silhouette against the flames, embers drifting. Every troop at once: the fire is spread evenly from edge to edge, with no single target.

What it does: 함정. 적 부대가 공격하면 그 공격이 취소됩니다.
Visual direction: A circle of runes drawn on the ground in chalk and small bones, glowing faint violet under a skin of mist. At its centre sits a small stitched cloth doll stuck with three iron pins. Black candles gutter at the edge of the circle. A patch of bare earth between headstones at night, seen from ground level, the circle almost invisible until the eye finds the doll. The attack never lands: the trap is quiet, patient and nearly hidden, the opposite of the Bear Trap's teeth.

What it does: 장비. 장착한 부대가 오브 2개를 얻습니다.
Visual direction: A breastplate made of ribs and a spine laced together with violet leather, shoulder guards cut from shoulder blades, a collar of small vertebrae, and tarnished iron buckles. It hangs on a wooden stand. A stone alcove in a crypt, green candles on the ledge beside it, cobwebs in the corners, cold moonlight through a slit window. Gear: two more orbs for whoever wears it. Displayed like a relic, alone.

What it does: 장소. 언데드(Undead) 부대의 공격력이 +1 됩니다.
Visual direction: A wide graveyard on a slope: crooked headstones, a leaning iron fence, open graves with fresh earth beside them, a dead black tree, and wrought-iron lanterns with green flames along a winding path that leads up to a rune-carved stone gateway. Deep night under a large full moon, mist lying in the hollows, the gateway glowing violet at the top of the hill. A place that makes every Undead stronger: the open graves are the detail to notice.
